items.source: On the classpath, bundle resources will be read with the locally configured encoding: by default, ISO-8859-1; consider switching this to UTF-8, or to null for the platform default encoding. On the JDK 9+ module path where locally provided ResourceBundle.Control handles are not supported, this MessageSource always falls back to ResourceBundle.getBundle(String) retrieval with the platform default encoding: UTF-8 with a ISO-8859-1 fallback on JDK 9+ (configurable through the "java.util.PropertyResourceBundle.encoding" system property). Note that loadBundle(Reader)/loadBundle(InputStream) won't be called in this case either, effectively ignoring overrides in subclasses. Consider implementing a JDK 9 java.util.spi.ResourceBundleProvider instead.
items.translation: 在类路径上，将使用本地配置的encoding读取捆绑资源；默认值为 ISO-8859-1；请考虑将其切换为 UTF-8，或切换为null以使用平台默认编码。在 JDK 9+ 的模块路径上，由于不支持本地提供的ResourceBundle.Control处理器，此 MessageSource 始终回退到ResourceBundle.getBundle(String)检索，使用平台默认编码：JDK 9+ 上为 UTF-8（带有 ISO-8859-1 回退），可通过"java.util.PropertyResourceBundle.encoding"系统属性配置。请注意，在这种情况下也不会调用loadBundle(Reader)/loadBundle(InputStream)，从而实际上忽略了子类中的覆盖实现。请考虑改为实现 JDK 9 的java.util.spi.ResourceBundleProvider。

items.source: This will be called in case of a "defaultEncoding", including ResourceBundleMessageSource's default ISO-8859-1 encoding. Note that this method can only be called with a ResourceBundle.Control: When running on the JDK 9+ module path where such control handles are not supported, any overrides in custom subclasses will effectively get ignored.
items.translation: 在遇到 `"defaultEncoding"`（包括 ResourceBundleMessageSource 的默认 ISO-8859-1 编码）时，将调用此方法。请注意，此方法只能使用 ResourceBundle.Control 进行调用：在 JDK 9+ 模块路径上运行时，由于不支持此类控制处理器，自定义子类中的任何重写都将实际上被忽略。

items.source: Default is the containing BeanFactory's bean ClassLoader, or the default ClassLoader determined by ClassUtils.getDefaultClassLoader() if not running within a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 默认值为包含的 `BeanFactory` 的 bean ClassLoader，或者如果不在 `BeanFactory` 中运行，则为 ClassUtils.getDefaultClassLoader() 确定的默认 ClassLoader。

items.source: This will only be called with "defaultEncoding" set to null, explicitly enforcing the platform default encoding (which is UTF-8 with a ISO-8859-1 fallback on JDK 9+ but configurable through the "java.util.PropertyResourceBundle.encoding" system property). Note that this method can only be called with a ResourceBundle.Control: When running on the JDK 9+ module path where such control handles are not supported, any overrides in custom subclasses will effectively get ignored.
items.translation: 这将仅在 `"defaultEncoding"` 设置为 null 时调用，从而显式强制使用平台默认编码（在 JDK 9+ 中默认为 UTF-8，带有 ISO-8859-1 回退机制，但可通过 "java.util.PropertyResourceBundle.encoding" 系统属性进行配置）。请注意，此方法仅可接受 ResourceBundle.Control：当在支持此类控制处理器的 JDK 9+ 模块路径上运行时，自定义子类中的任何重写都将实际上被忽略。

items.source: The basenames follow ResourceBundle conventions: essentially, a fully-qualified classpath location. If it doesn't contain a package qualifier (such as org.mypackage), it will be resolved from the classpath root. Note that the JDK's standard ResourceBundle treats dots as package separators: This means that "test.theme" is effectively equivalent to "test/theme".
items.translation: 基名遵循ResourceBundle约定：本质上，这是一个完全限定的类路径位置。如果它不包含包限定符（例如org.mypackage），则将从类路径根目录解析。请注意，JDK 的标准 ResourceBundle 将点视为包分隔符：这意味着"test.theme"实际上等同于"test/theme"。

items.source: As of 4.2, the default implementation checks containsKey before it attempts to call getString (which would require catching MissingResourceException for key not found).
items.translation: 自 4.2 版本起，默认实现会在尝试调用getString（这需要捕获键未找到的MissingResourceException）之前先检查containsKey。

items.source: This MessageSource caches both the accessed ResourceBundle instances and the generated MessageFormats for each message. It also implements rendering of no-arg messages without MessageFormat, as supported by the AbstractMessageSource base class. The caching provided by this MessageSource is significantly faster than the built-in caching of the java.util.ResourceBundle class.
items.translation: 此 MessageSource 缓存了已访问的 ResourceBundle 实例以及为每个消息生成的 MessageFormats。它还实现了无需 MessageFormat 的无参消息渲染，这得到了 AbstractMessageSource 基类的支持。此 MessageSource 提供的缓存速度显著快于 java.util.ResourceBundle 类的内置缓存。

Resolves the given message code as key in the registered resource bundles,
using a cached MessageFormat instance per message code.
items.translation: 使用每个消息代码对应的缓存 MessageFormat 实例，将给定的消息代码作为键解析在已注册的资源包中。

returning the value found in the bundle as-is (without MessageFormat parsing).
items.translation: 将给定的消息代码作为键在已注册的资源包中解析，并以原样返回资源包中找到的值（不进行 MessageFormat 解析）。
